format: C++/C++-style source file (with .mm extension, indicating Objective-C++ style)
description: This file contains implementation of adaptive pooling operations (average and max pooling) optimized for Apple’s Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within the ATen native namespace of PyTorch. It includes set-up of kernel parameters, forward and backward functions for adaptive average pooling, and functions for adaptive max pooling, with internal checks and memory management.

methods.name: set_kernel_params
methods.description: Configures stride and kernel size parameters for adaptive pooling based on input and output sizes, ensuring valid input/output relationships.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_out_mps
methods.description: Performs adaptive average pooling forward operation tailored for MPS, handling both 'larger input' and 'smaller input' scenarios with necessary checks and computations.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_mps
methods.description: High-level wrapper that computes output shape, allocates output tensor, and calls the out variant for adaptive average pooling.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_backward_mps
methods.description: Computes the gradient of adaptive average pooling for backward pass, considering kernel parameters and input/output sizes.
